description: The line plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy (measured as Pass@8) for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The plot displays three distinct lines: the On-policy RL method is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, the LUFFY method by a red line with star markers, and the SFT method by a teal line with triangle markers. The On-policy RL line starts at an accuracy of approximately 66.0 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to a peak of about 75.0 at a temperature of 0.8, and then declines to around 73.0 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY line begins at an accuracy of approximately 76.0 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuates with a peak of about 79.0 at a temperature of 0.9, and ends at approximately 78.0 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT line starts at an accuracy of about 76.0 at a temperature of 0.1, decreases to a low of approximately 70.0 at a temperature of 0.5, then rises to a peak of about 77.0 at a temperature of 0.6, and finally declines to around 74.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
